title: Refill - pharmacy
text: Patient called stating the pharmacy has not received the prescription yet.

title: Voicemail
text: Called patient - no answer. Left voicemail requesting a return call.

title: Prior auth
text: Insurance denied prior authorization. Team will submit the appeal per workflow.

title: Wait time
text: Patient expressed concern about wait time. Apologized and offered a supervisor callback.

title: Portal message
text: Portal message reviewed and routed to the provider for a clinical response.

title: Opening line
text: Thank you for calling Siya Health. How may I help you today?

title: Pull chart
text: One moment please - let me pull up your chart and confirm your visit details.

title: Empathy
text: I hear you - I'm here to help. Can you tell me what happened?

title: Provider unavailable
text: Dr. Smith is unavailable today. We will contact you shortly to arrange the next appointment.

title: Heads up
text: Heads up - the provider is running fifteen minutes behind today.

title: Circle back
text: I'll circle back with billing once I have the invoice number.

title: Touch base
text: Let's touch base after your shift about the backlog on the schedule.

title: Secure channel
text: Please send that through the patient portal or approved secure channel - not personal email.

title: Follow-up
text: I'll follow up tomorrow if we don't hear back from billing by then.

title: Escalation
text: I'll loop in the supervisor with a short summary - no patient identifiers in this thread.

title: Shift handoff (pro)
text: End-of-shift handoff (IST → EST overlap): three portal threads remain open — (1) refill status for pharmacy #4821, (2) prior-auth appeal packet due by Friday 5:00 p.m. ET, and (3) supervisor callback promised after yesterday's wait-time complaint. Do not paste DOB, MRN, or full street address into Slack; use the chart note + approved secure channel only. If billing replies after 8:00 p.m. IST, park it for the next on-call MA and leave a one-line "circle back" flag.

title: Reschedule script (pro)
text: "Thanks for holding — I'm confirming Tuesday, March 18 at 10:30 a.m. Eastern (that's 8:00 p.m. IST on your side). If that doesn't work, I can offer Wednesday 2:15 p.m. ET or a same-week telehealth slot. I'll send the portal invite within 15 minutes; please complete the intake forms before the visit. Anything else I can help with before we hang up?"

title: Benefits clarification (pro)
text: Hi — following up on your benefits question. Coverage for this visit type depends on your plan's in-network rules, deductible status, and any prior-authorization requirement. I can't quote a final patient-responsibility amount from chat; billing can review once we have the CPT/ICD pairing from the provider. Reply in the portal (not personal email) with your member ID last four digits only, and we'll route this to billing within one business day.

title: Privacy redirect (pro)
text: Quick privacy note: please don't send lab PDFs, insurance cards, or full SSN over WhatsApp/SMS. Upload through the patient portal or the approved secure channel, then reply here with "uploaded — see portal." If you're stuck on login, I can walk you through reset steps (no passwords in this thread). For urgent symptoms, call the clinic line or use emergency services — chat isn't for medical emergencies.

title: Ops English (pro)
text: Heads-up for the afternoon desk: Dr. Patel's 1:00–3:30 block is double-booked after a same-day add-on; please (a) warn arriving patients of a 20–25 minute delay, (b) offer a callback or telehealth swap where appropriate, and (c) escalate to the charge MA if anyone mentions leaving a negative review mid-wait. Keep tone calm, specific, and short — no over-promising exact start times.

title: New-patient intake (pro)
text: For new-patient intake I'll need: preferred name + legal name if different, best callback number, time zone, insurance vs. self-pay, and whether you've been seen here before under another spelling. I'll also confirm pharmacy name/city (not Rx numbers on this call unless the workflow requires it). After we book, watch for a portal invite — forms must be done 24 hours ahead or we may need to reschedule. Questions before I place the hold?
